packageRules.description: pi's SDK is pre-1.0 and on a fast release train. It is the only dependency that can break the typecheck, so it gets a PR to itself.
TypeScript and its node types are one toolchain and interact. Review them together.
Both actions serve the publish workflow. One PR, one decision.
The peer range is this extension's compatibility claim. Raise it only when the code adopts an API that needs it, never because a new pi shipped. Keep this rule last so it overrides the rules above.
